title: Appointment of a Cabinet Sub Committee for organizing activities of the 78th Independence Day Ceremony
decision_details: - Taking into consideration a proposal submitted by the Minister of Public Administration, Provincial Councils and Local Government, the Cabinet granted its approval to appoint a Cabinet Sub-Committee chaired by the Hon. Prime Minister and with the participation of the relevant Hon. Ministers concerned, to oversee and provide guidance pertaining to the activities of the 78th Independence Day Ceremony falling on 2026-02-04
